name: Nishihara (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nishihara town emblem in white: a ring open at the top beneath a winged device of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Nishihara, a town in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 July 1968.

features.role: Nishihara town emblem — a ring open at the top beneath a winged device of horizontal strokes
